paragraphs: The STM32 Blue Pill is a popular microcontroller board designed for beginners and hobbyists. It features the ARM Cortex-M3 processor, which operates at a clock speed of 72 MHz. The Blue Pill has a 64 KB Flash memory and 20 KB SRAM, providing ample resources for software development.

The STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller is a member of the STM32 series, specifically the F103 series. This part offers a balance between performance and cost, making it suitable for various applications such as embedded systems, IoT devices, and educational projects.

The Cortex-M3 processor is a 32-bit RISC-V architecture that provides high-performance, low-power capabilities. It supports a wide range of peripherals, including timers, ADCs, and GPIOs, which are essential for the development of various applications.

The Blue Pill's on-board indicator LED (PC13) is an active-low pin that illuminates automatically when the plant needs watering. This feature helps users monitor the moisture level in their plants and take appropriate actions.

The Soil Moisture Sensor Module is a device that measures the moisture content of soil using capacitive or resistive probes. The module outputs an analog voltage, which can be read by the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller to determine the moisture level.

The Active Buzzer Alert Module is a digital GPIO pin (PA1) that activates when the moisture level falls below a predefined threshold. This feature provides audible notifications to users and helps them take immediate action to water their plants.

The ST-Link V2 In-Circuit Programmer is a hardware tool used for flashing firmware onto STM32 microcontrollers and debugging purposes. It supports SWD (Serial Wire Debug) communication, which allows developers to program the microcontroller and debug its behavior.
